archive-permanent-delete-disabled-hint: Loko eka Admin Panel / Problems / Delete ku hlawuriwile Enable permanent delete for Global Admin, kutani laha ku ta voniwa bathoni ya ku Susa.
attachment-download-limit-label: Vukulu lebyikulu bya fayili ya ku dawuniloda swikhomanisiwa
attachment-transfer-limits-description: Lulamisa mimpimo ya vukulu lebyikulu bya tifayili eka ku khandziyisa na ku dawuniloda. Ku hlayisela nkarhinyana ka ku rhumela hi API ku na mimpimo ya vuhlayiseki yo hambana eka sevha.
attachment-transfer-limits-invalid-value: Ndza kombela u nghenisa ntikelo wa mpimo lowu faneleke lowu nga ehenhla ka zero
attachment-transfer-limits-saved: Mimpimo ya ku rhumela swikhomanisiwa yi hlayisiwile.
attachment-transfer-limits-title: Mimpimo ya Vukulu bya Swikhomanisiwa na Tifayili ta API
attachment-upload-limit-label: Vukulu lebyikulu bya fayili ya ku khandziyisa swikhomanisiwa
automatic-linked-url-schemes: Swikimi swa URL swo tiendlela leswi faneleke ku tshikileleka hi swoxe. Xikimi xin'we xa URL eka layini yin'wana na yin'wana
board-creation-admin-only: Vafambisi ntsena va nga endla mabhodo lamantsha
board-view-size-cycle-time: Vukulu bya ntirho na nkarhi wa xirhendzevutani
confirm-move-list-to-swimlane: Rhurhisa nxaxamelo lowu na tikhadi ta wona hinkwato eka ndlela yin'wana?
default-on-private-board: Xa ntolovelo eka bodo ya xihundla
default-on-public-board: Xa ntolovelo eka bodo ya vanhu hinkwavo
delete-board-confirm-popup: Minxaxamelo hinkwayo, makhadi, swikombiso na mintirho swi ta susiwa naswona a wu nge swi koti ku vuyisa leswi a swi ri eka bodo. A ku na ku tlherisela endzhaku.
drag-to-reorder: Koka ku cinca nandzelelano. Tikunupu ta miseve ya le henhla ni le hansi ti fambisa ndhawu yin’we.
enable-permanent-delete: Pfula ku susa loku nga heriki eka Mulawuri wa Misava
enable-permanent-delete-description: Pfumelela Valawuri va Misava ku susa hi ku helela swilo leswi susiweke hi ndlela yo olova. Ku pfula xiyimiso lexi a swi susi swilo hi swoxe.
feature-approval-required: Siya swihlawulekisi leswi engeteriweke hi mimpfuxeto ya WeKan swi nga tirhi ku fikela loko mulawuri a swi pfulela
feature-board-summary-desc: Menyu ya bodo → Nkomiso wu kombisa leswi un'wana na un'wana a swi endleke eka bodo hi siku kumbe vhiki ro hetelela, na leswi swi hundzeriweke hi nkarhi.
feature-pilot-users: Vatirhisi vo ringeta lava tlhelaka va vona swihlawulekisi leswi nga tirheki
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Mavito ya vatirhisi, lama hambanisiweke hi tikhoma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Swi hlayisiwile. Mavito lawa ya vatirhisi a ma kumekanga:
feature-preview-admins: Valawuri va vona swihlawulekisi leswi nga tirheki leswaku va ta swi ringeta ku sungula
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menyu ya bodo → Milawu yi ringanyeta milawu ku suka eka leswi vanhu va swi endlaka hi voko nkarhi na nkarhi.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Ku lava hinkwako ku twisisa swiga swo fana na "tikhadi ta mina leti hundzeriweke hi nkarhi".
feature-since-last-visit: Ku sukela eka ku endzela ka wena ko hetelela
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menyu ya bodo → Ku sukela eka ku endzela ka wena ko hetelela ku kombisa leswi van'wana va swi cinceke eka bodo.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Khalendara ni khalendara ya tibodo to tala.
feature-views-chat-desc: Bodo tanihi ndhawu ya ntirho ya mbulavurisano: tindhawu ta ntirho, tibodo, tindlela, minxaxamelo na tikhadi tanihi murhi wa tichanele, khadi exikarhi na mimbulavulo ya rona tanihi mahungu ya mbulavurisano.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Tikhadi leti fanaka eka mintlawa yo hlayanyana ya tikholomu leyi nga na mavito - hi ku hetiwa, nkoka, xiyimo kumbe xin'wana - leti fambisiwaka exikarhi ka tikholomu hi ku koka.
feature-views-email-desc: Bodo tanihi bokisi ra poso: nxaxamelo wa imeyili i Bokisi ra leswi nghenaka, minxaxamelo i tifolda, swikombiso i swikombiso, naswona swirho swi tsala no hlamula imeyili hi adirese ya bodo.
feature-views-flow-charts: Tichati ta ku khuluka ka mintirho
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Mintirho leyi saleke, mintirho leyi hetiweke, ku khuluka loku hlengeletiweke, nkarhi wo tirha ni wo rindza, nhlayo ya mintirho leyi hetiweke, nkarhi lowu mintirho yi wu heteke yi rindzile, swihingakanyi, Monte Carlo ni swipimo swin'wana swa ku khuluka ka mintirho.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Tindlela tinharhu to languta tichati ta Gantt.
feature-views-map-desc: Makhadi tani hi swikombiso eka xifaniso lexi layichiweke.
feature-views-overview-desc: Tinhlayo, ku hlanganisa hi munhu loyi a nyikiweke ntirho, kungu ra ndlela, deshibodo ni bodo leyikulu.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Mintirho ya xitirhisiwa leyi saleke, minkarhi yo koma ya ku tirha, xiviko xa nkarhi wolowo ni rivilo ra ku tirha.
feature-views-table-desc: Bodo tani hi tafula ra makhadi lama nga longoloxiwaka.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Bodo tanihi xilandzeleri xa mintlhontlho xa GitHub kumbe Gitea: makhadi tanihi mintlhontlho, swikombiso ni swiyimo swa nkoka, mimbulavulo tanihi mbulavulo, swihlanganisi tanihi tifayela, ni matimu ya bodo ni ku tlherisela.
home-board-badge: Bodo ya Ekaya (yi pfuriwa endzhaku ko nghena)
home-board-empty: Koka u veka laha bodo yin'we ntsena ku yi pfula endzhaku ko nghena
home-board-remove-confirm: Susa bodo leyi eka Ekaya? Bodo hi yoxe a yi susiwi.
multi-selection-on: Ku hlawula swo tala ku pfuriwile
password-length-report-title: Ku leha ka xiletelo xa xihundla
password-min-length-enforce: Sindzisa ku leha ka le hansi
password-mismatch: Swiletelo swa xihundla a swi fambelani
read-assigned-only: Ku hlaya ntsena eka leswi averiweke
select-only-one-board: Hi kombela u hlawula bodo yin'we ntsena
set-selected-home: Veka tanihi bodo ya Ekaya (yi pfuriwa endzhaku ko nghena)
set-selected-unstarred: Susa nyeleti eka tibodo leti hlawuriweke
show-desktop-drag-handles: Kombisa swikhomo swo koka eka desktop
show-on-public-board: Kombisa eka bodo ya vanhu hinkwavo
